prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE new actual rendered animation frame (not a sheet), exact pose of reference image2.
References: image1 original alien IDENTITY, image2 single pose CONTROL, image3 accepted running frame0 for exact fixed canvas/camera registration, head/eye/face shape, skin microtexture, vest and pants material, boot size and lighting. Image3 pose must change according to image2; keep its upper body, head and canvas framing pixel-consistent. Face RIGHT, strict side orthographic view, same gentle forward lean. Image2 red=permanent NEAR foreground arm+leg, blue=permanent FAR background arm+leg. Diagram shows blue proximal arm through torso for structural clarity only; final natural clothing and skin, no colored bones or labels. TWO connected arms, TWO independent fists and TWO legs/boots must visibly participate.
Exact beige speckled bald large elongated cranium, huge blue eye, small friendly face, slim body, olive sleeveless expedition vest, cream undershirt, brown belted cargo trousers, dark brown lace-up boots. The foreground NEAR thigh carries the large outer cargo pocket; the FAR thigh must not inherit it. Track this identity permanently even when near leg swings behind or crosses in front. No camera yaw or perspective swap. No face/head/eye-size changes. Forward gaze and slight closed-mouth smile stable, no blink in this short run cycle.
Fixed 1086×1448 portrait canvas like image3. Use the same body scale, hip position, head position and planted sole baseline of image3; slight natural pelvis bob only, feet may lift in airborne phases. Raw canvas motion envelope: generous head clearance and at least64px side clearance for all hands and boots, no source crop. Keep full body inside frame. Never zoom to fill or recenter per pose. Genuine alpha transparency, no floor/shadow/text/lines. High-quality detailed coherent 3D rendering, smooth natural joints, wrists attached and fists softly closed. Render both arm gestures even when far upper arm is occluded; separate far fist visibly from near fist and torso.
RUN5/12: NEAR cargo-pocket-bearing heel folds close behind buttock during recovery, knee down/back; FAR leg extends forward/down preparing contact, far sole a little ABOVE planted baseline. NEAR arm forward/up with near fist in front of chest; FAR arm backswing with fist behind hip. Intermediate approach to FAR-foot contact, not the identical contact pose.
